Name: Bear Family Simple Foliage Fersken Peach Tree
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
Do you use Simple Foliage? Do you use Bear Family? Do you want the Fersken Peach Tree to match Simple Foliage? I got you covered. Versions included for vanilla, Earthy, Starblue, and VPR recolors, with manual and automatic configuration. Also fixed a weird stump/trunk mismatch from using Simple Foliage peach trees as a base.

This is a content patcher mod, so you don't have to worry about the file being overwritten with updates!

1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16197]Bear Family[/url].
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url].
4. Install this mod.

[b]THANKS:
[/b]MadDogOfBlank for Bear Family!
Itsanette for Simple Foliage!
